# NPM Improved v1.6.5 — Proxy-host error diagnostics hotfix

## Proxy hosts
- Identify whether proxy-host creation or editing fails during SSL certificate issuance or Nginx configuration.
- Preserve existing safe validation messages rather than replacing them with generic errors.
- Include a unique request reference with otherwise-private proxy-host server errors, and log the corresponding reference for troubleshooting without exposing sensitive internals.

## Operational notes
- Existing proxy-host configuration and proxy routing behavior are unchanged.
- This release improves error reporting and diagnosis; it does not yet repair the underlying host-save failures, which require live error evidence.
- No additional containers or dependencies are introduced.
